title: Expand Tdarr Matrix Diagnostics Console
summary: Expand the Diagnostics Tdarr Matrix panel into a backend-owned console for findings exploration, evidence opening, targeted reruns, bucket coverage, and run comparison.
reason: Operators need to inspect Tdarr Matrix report findings and evidence from the Diagnostics UI without opening JSON manually or submitting arbitrary filesystem paths from the browser.
behavior_before: The Tdarr Matrix Diagnostics panel could run fixed audit presets and render a bounded findings preview after a command completed.
behavior_after: The panel can load latest run diagnostics, filter/select findings, open backend-resolved evidence targets, request targeted reruns by finding key, review bucket coverage, and compare runs while preserving backend-owned path and process safety.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py console read model, evidence, comparison, and rerun selector tests
tests/python/desktop/test_api_command_contracts.py strict keyed Tdarr Matrix evidence/rerun payload tests
tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py Tdarr Matrix console rendering and keyed payload tests
manual_validation: 2026-06-08: change-control validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated pre-existing coverage gaps and MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010 missing date_completed
rollback_plan: Remove the Tdarr Matrix console read/action routes, parser helpers, WebView controls, and focused tests, then refresh summaries and rerun the targeted diagnostics/WebView suites.
notes:
Do not expose arbitrary frontend filesystem paths; all evidence and rerun operations must use run IDs, finding keys, and allowlisted target names.
Implement Tdarr Matrix Diagnostics Console with findings explorer, evidence target keys, rerun selectors, bucket coverage, and run comparison.
Implemented Tdarr Matrix diagnostics console read models, evidence opening, targeted reruns, bucket coverage, run comparison, and WebView controls.
Registered generated summaries refreshed for the Tdarr Matrix diagnostics console change.
Final change-control coverage failure was unrelated to this packet: MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010 missing date_completed plus uncovered dirty files under dependency-atlas subtitle images, MP-CHANGE-2026-0607-020 summary, core/kernel dto_status/models_core summaries, and core/kernel dto_status.py/models_core.py.
